Welcome to ZALMI Institute

LEARN TO SPEAK, RISE TO PEAK

ZALMI Institute is a modern learning center for English, IT, and academic excellence, established on 22 August 2026. Our mission is to give young people (ZALMI) modern English and IT skills and the confidence to compete in today's world.

🗣️

English Language Programs

Spoken English, grammar, conversation and IELTS.

Computer & IT Courses

CIT and DIT, registered with Peshawar Technical Board.

🖋️

Creative Calligraphy

Arabic, English, Urdu, Modern and Gothic styles.

📚

Academic Tuition

Playgroup to Matric, Science and Arts.

A modern learning center for English, IT and academic excellence.

Our mission

To provide modern English and IT skills to youth (ZALMI) and equip them with the confidence and abilities to compete in the modern world.

Courses

Classes run 6 days a week, 2:00 PM to 8:00 PM.

English Language Programs

Each level takes 3 months. Curriculum: New Intercom Series.

Foundation

Active 1, 2, 3

Intermediate

Level 1, 2, 3, 4

Advanced

Intensive 1, 2

Weekend specialized classes

Special Grammar Class

Descriptive and Prescriptive Grammar, Parts of Speech, Figures of Speech, Tenses, Active and Passive Voice, Direct and Indirect Speech.

Special Conversation Class

Daily-life speaking, interviews, presentations, debates, role-plays and more.

IELTS Preparation

6 months with mock tests, taught by Diyar Khan (30+ years of experience).

Computer & IT

CIT: Certificate in IT

3 months. MS Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint and CorelDRAW. Registered with Peshawar Technical Board.

DIT: Diploma in IT

1 year. Curriculum as per Peshawar Technical Board. Registered with Peshawar Technical Board.

Calligraphy

Learn Arabic, English, Urdu, Modern and Gothic styles in 3 months.

Tuition Classes

      Frequently Asked Questions

      What are the class timings?

      2:00 PM to 8:00 PM, 6 days a week.

      Are there separate classes for girls?

      Yes, with assigned female staff.

      How many students are in each class?

      15 students per class.

      What is the admission fee?

      Rs. 2,000 for each program. Course fees are on the Fee Structure page.

      Are CIT and DIT certificates recognized?

      Yes. Both are registered with the Peshawar Technical Board.

      Which documents are needed?

      None.

      Can I try a class first?

      Yes. Ask for a Free Demo Class.
